purpose_zh: 在既有六类 persona 之外，补充青年初入行者、开发者与研究者、首次到访者与国际访客三类公共利益覆盖；每类都回接既有场景、空间、人工替代、影响风险和停止条件。
purpose_en: Extend the existing six-persona protocol with youth and early entrants, developers and researchers, and first-time or international visitors. Each extension returns to existing scenarios, spatial anchors, human alternatives, impact risks, and stop conditions.

extensions.group_en: Youth, students, and people entering the workforce
extensions.benefit_zh: 获得不以自动评分筛选的技能再造、人工解释和可撤回学习入口。
extensions.benefit_en: Access a reskilling, staffed-explanation, and withdrawable learning entry without automated eligibility scoring.
extensions.impact_risk_zh: 岗位转型压力、污名化、等待时间和学习数据被过度留存。
extensions.impact_risk_en: Transition pressure, stigma, waiting time, and excessive retention of learning data.
extensions.human_alternative_zh: 纸本、电话和人工咨询可以跳过自动分流；不使用数字工具不影响获取公共说明。
extensions.human_alternative_en: Paper, phone, and staffed advice may bypass automated routing; refusing a digital tool must not remove public information.
extensions.stop_if_zh: 没有人工咨询、退出记录或岗位质量资料时，停在 G0，不开放自动分流。
extensions.stop_if_en: Without staffed advice, an exit record, or job-quality evidence, remain at G0 and do not open automated routing.
extensions.evidence_needed_zh: 青年和初入行者基线、带薪/高质量岗位资料、可理解性走读和独立申诉记录。
extensions.evidence_needed_en: Youth and early-entry baselines, paid or quality-job evidence, comprehension walk-throughs, and independent redress records.

extensions.benefit_zh: 在最小权限、可解释目录和公共观察席下参与受限实验，不把平台评分当作入场资格。
extensions.benefit_en: Participate in bounded experiments through least-privilege, explainable catalogues and a public observer seat without platform scoring as an entry rule.
extensions.impact_risk_zh: 供应商锁定、知识产权不清、测试外溢和个人/市政数据被误接入。
extensions.impact_risk_en: Vendor lock-in, unclear intellectual property, test spillover, and accidental connection to personal or civic data.
extensions.human_alternative_zh: 人工目录台、纸面协议和公共观察席先于 API 调用；无授权时只讨论问题，不调用数据。
extensions.human_alternative_en: A staffed catalogue desk, paper protocol, and public observer seat precede any API call; without authorization, discuss the problem only and call no data.
extensions.stop_if_zh: 授权、权利、日志或人工接管不清时冻结实验，回到纸面协议和普通公共服务。
extensions.stop_if_en: Freeze the experiment and return to the paper protocol and ordinary public service when authorization, rights, logs, or human takeover are unclear.
extensions.evidence_needed_zh: 数据目录、最小权限、权利清单、事故回放、供应商冲突披露和独立复核记录。
extensions.evidence_needed_en: Data catalogue, least-privilege record, rights register, incident replay, vendor conflict disclosure, and independent review.

extensions.group_zh: 首次到访者与国际访客
extensions.benefit_zh: 在不熟悉本地系统的情况下获得多语公共信息、人工解释、普通通行和可退出服务。
extensions.benefit_en: Receive multilingual public information, staffed explanation, ordinary movement, and a withdrawable service without knowing the local system.
extensions.impact_risk_zh: 语言障碍、错误的医疗/生活信息、个案数据误收集和文化误读。
extensions.impact_risk_en: Language barriers, incorrect health or daily-life guidance, accidental collection of case data, and cultural misreading.
extensions.human_alternative_zh: 多语人工前台和纸本说明与数字界面并列；不接入真实签证、医疗或商业个案库。
extensions.human_alternative_en: A multilingual staffed desk and paper explanation remain beside the digital interface; no real visa, health, or commercial case database is connected.
extensions.stop_if_zh: 语言解释、权利清单或个案数据授权不完整时关闭展示，保留普通通行和人工服务。
extensions.stop_if_en: Close the display and retain ordinary movement and staffed service when language explanation, rights notice, or case-data authorization is incomplete.
extensions.evidence_needed_zh: 多语可理解性走读、服务准确性核验、文化审校、撤回记录和投诉处置记录。
extensions.evidence_needed_en: Multilingual comprehension walk-throughs, service-accuracy checks, cultural review, withdrawal records, and complaint disposition.

boundary_zh: 本文件是公共利益覆盖和证据缺口登记，不是人口调查、无障碍认证、服务绩效、就业结果或官方评分。正式基线和授权资料到位后，须与 persona、scenario、geometry、metrics、图件、HTML、PDF 和 self-check 一起重算。
boundary_en: This file is a public-interest coverage and evidence-gap register, not a demographic survey, accessibility certification, service outcome, employment result, or official score. Recompute it with personas, scenarios, geometry, metrics, figures, HTML, PDFs, and self-check after formal baselines and authorization arrive.
